title: dockerstage knowledge base (spec v2 §7.1)
description: Per-package native-dependency knowledge base. Entry shape is fixed by PROJECT_SPEC.md §7.1 including the three v2 changes: distro-keyed dep maps, import_names, verified_by_build.

schema_version.description: Tracks the spec §7.1 schema revision, not the KB content version.

generated_notes.description: Free-text provenance/curation conventions for the file as a whole.

entries.description: Spec §7.1 initial target size is 60-150 entries.

distroDepMap.description: System package names keyed by distro FAMILY (v2 change (a)). The debian key is mandatory; alpine is optional and currently unused under the §9.1 Debian-only output policy.

items.description: A real distro package name, lowercase. Must be installable by the target package manager.

name.description: PEP 503 normalised distribution name (lowercase, runs of -_. collapsed to a single -).

version_range.description: '*' unless native deps genuinely differ by version.

import_names.description: v2 change (b): module names for the §10.2 Test A smoke test. Cannot be derived from the distribution name. MAY be empty for console-script-only packages (e.g. gunicorn), which Test C covers instead.

extras.description: Variant-dependent deps, keyed by PEP 508 extra or variant name (e.g. uvicorn[standard], torch cuda).

wheel_typically_available.description: Documentation aid and offline fallback ONLY. The live §7.2 check is authoritative and must win any disagreement. Verify against PyPI during curation; never inherit.

source.description: Recorded honestly per entry; §14.3 reports accuracy broken down by this field.

verified_by_build.description: v2 change (c): set true only once a §10 build actually confirms the entry.
